title: Mallworld Discord Server
content: The purpose of this post is to gauge interest in a public discord server dedicated to the walkers and dreamers of Mallworld. The discord would serve as a repository of mallworld experiences and dream analyses, while giving people a chance to meet and talk to others with similar experiences. Seeing how our community has grown, and all the connections and revelations people make, has inspired me to create a shared space where people can continue to forge those connections and explore the Mallworld!
